_comment: Retargets calc/tools/build_device.py at this port. Everything under calc/core listed here is shared with SITE-K and is NOT forked: tables.c (font + sine), util.c (integer maths) and fb.c (1-bit framebuffer) are compiled straight out of the sibling tree. Only sctables.c, geo.c, socaldata.c and app.c belong to SOCAL SUBSURFACE.
